admissionAndRetention.sequential: Run focused-original once, inspect complete raw results, then focused-synthesized once only if original fully passed and source remains frozen.
admissionAndRetention.stdoutStderr: Open fresh raw output files exclusively; preserve all bytes including failures/cancellations and partial output. No synthetic replacement or overwrites.
admissionAndRetention.failure: First nonzero exit, signal, timeout, missing selected result, unexpected skip, source/alias/tool mismatch or evidence error stops all later phases. Preserve primary failure, argv, return code/signal, timestamps, raw logs and their hashes. No retry or source change under this plan.
admissionAndRetention.cancel: Use an outer process group and SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers; record interruption before forwarding SIGTERM to the wrapper, wait/reap, escalate whole group to SIGKILL after bounded10seconds if still live, and mark failure even if child exits0. Do not swallow cancellation during final receipt write.
admissionAndRetention.after: Recheck actual source/alias/tool identities and exact HEAD/tree, inventory/hash raw files, parse TAP actual counters and selected identities; write status only after all evidence checks. Keep failures and first attempt.
admissionAndRetention.harness: Scratch source-pinned recorder reuses scripts/limited.js; runs only the two approved argv arrays sequentially and guards all initial/intermediate/final saves, preserving primary error, secondary inspections, partial atomic-write files and a failure sidecar/stderr fallback.
